what: Teal Modules for Hy's Law Monitoring and eDISH Plots
title: Teal Modules for Hy's Law Monitoring and eDISH Plots
text: Teal modules reusable builders exploratory Hy’s Law monitoring CDISC ADaM-style ADSL + ADLB. review aid, submission TFL. implement alternative-cause exclusion (pre-existing liver disease, obstruction, alcohol). Admiral ADLBHY derives ADaM flags; dv.edish hep-explorer interactive eDISH apps stacks. package sits : table/plot builders Shiny, plus optional teal modules. Peak eDISH maxima biochemical potential Hy’s Law. scatter uses -treatment peaks need occur day. Red open circles mark concurrent-window cases (optional ALP exclusion). Study-specific ADDILI input; package documents ADLB algorithm instead.

title: Teal Modules for Hy's Law Monitoring and eDISH Plots
text: Peak eDISH can look like Hy’s Law two peaks weeks apart. Concurrent-window classification monitoring rule. window_days = 7 30 can match SAP. Missing ALP imputed.

title: Teal Modules for Hy's Law Monitoring and eDISH Plots
text: Always (subject-level): -treatment peak ALT / ULN, AST / ULN, ALT AST / ULN, BILI / ULN, ALP / ULN Baseline peaks peak / baseline (mDISH) ABLFL ADY <= 0 present eDISH quadrant: Hy’s Law, Temple’s corollary, Cholestasis, Normal near normal Cholestatic ALP-vs-BILI quadrant Concurrent Hy’s Law flag dates; concurrent cholestatic flag ALP-elevated--window, missing-ALP, potential Hy’s Law optional ALP exclusion R-ratio hepatocellular / mixed / cholestatic pattern default summary table two sections: four peak-quadrant counts (ST&F-style maximal abnormalities) biochemical concurrent counts. build_liver_elevation_table() adds nested 3/5/10/20x 1.5/2x elevations plus combination row split ALP. listing adds R-ratio; symptoms alternative causes ADLB filled.

title: Build Hy's Law / eDISH review tables — build_hyslaw_table
code: data <- make_synthetic_hyslaw_data(n_extra = 0L, seed = 1L) build_hyslaw_table(data$ADSL, data$ADLB) #> Hy's Law monitoring (exploratory) #> Peak eDISH cuts: ALT/AST >= 3x ULN, BILI >= 2x ULN (on-treatment maxima) #> Concurrent window: 14 days after ALT/AST elevation; ALP exclusion on; operator >= #>  #> ———————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————— #>                                                                                Placebo    Investigational    Total   #>                                                                                 (N=4)          (N=6)         (N=10)  #> ———————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————— #> Maximal treatment-emergent liver tests (peak eDISH)                                                                  #>   ALT or AST >= 3x ULN and BILI >= 2x ULN (peak Hy's Law quadrant)             1 (25.0)      3 (50.0)       4 (40.0) #>   Temple's corollary                                                           1 (25.0)      1 (16.7)       2 (20.0) #>   Cholestasis (isolated hyperbilirubinemia)                                    1 (25.0)      1 (16.7)       2 (20.0) #>   Normal or near normal                                                        1 (25.0)      1 (16.7)       2 (20.0) #> Biochemical concurrent Hy's Law (14-day window)                                                                      #>   ALT or AST >= 3x ULN and BILI >= 2x ULN in window                            1 (25.0)      2 (33.3)       3 (30.0) #>   Concurrent with ALP >= 2x ULN in window                                      0 (0.0)       1 (16.7)       1 (10.0) #>   Potential Hy's Law after ALP exclusion                                       1 (25.0)      1 (16.7)       2 (20.0) #>   Cholestatic concurrent (BILI >= 2x ULN within 14 days after ALP >= 2x ULN)   0 (0.0)       1 (16.7)       1 (10.0) #> ———————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————— #>  #> Exploratory review table; not a submission TFL. #> Threshold operator is >= (FDA 2009 and many CSR shells use >; change classify_hyslaw(compare = ">") to match). #> Peak eDISH / maximal abnormalities use each subject's on-treatment maximum ALT or AST / ULN versus maximum bilirubin / ULN. The two maxima are not required to occur on the same day. Baseline records (ABLFL = Y) are excluded from those maxima. #> Biochemical concurrent Hy's Law: bilirubin >= 2x ULN on or after ALT/AST >= 3x ULN, within 14 days. This is not the peak-quadrant count and is not a confirmed Hy's Law case. #> Potential Hy's Law applies optional ALP >= 2x ULN exclusion in the same window (currently on). Missing ALP is not imputed; subjects without ALP meeting the cut in the window are retained when exclusion is on. #> R-ratio = (ALT/ULN)/(ALP/ULN) at the concurrent ALT date when both exist, otherwise peak ALT/ULN over peak ALP/ULN. Pattern: >=5 hepatocellular, >2 and <5 mixed, <=2 cholestatic. #> Symptoms, alternative causes, and 'satisfies Hy's Law' are not assessed from ADLB.

title: Classify eDISH peak quadrants and concurrent Hy's Law — classify_hyslaw
text: Peak eDISH uses subject's -treatment maximum ALT AST / ULN versus maximum bilirubin / ULN (necessarily day). Concurrent (biochemical potential) Hy's Law requires bilirubin meeting bili_cut ALT/AST meeting alt_cut, within window_days. title: tm.hyslaw 0.2.0
text: Added R CMD check pkgdown GitHub Actions workflows release-ready open-source development. Added _pkgdown.yml reference grouping lightweight .lintr configuration. README now includes CI/pkgdown badges local quality-gate commands. Fixed R CMD check NOTE unqualified runif() using stats::runif(). eDISH plot defaults one panel colored treatment, quadrant names plot red open circles biochemical potential Hy’s Law. Caption states axis maxima need day. Optional mDISH (= "mdish") cholestatic ALP vs bilirubin screen (= "cholestatic"). Faceting group opt-. Peak maxima use -treatment records; baseline kept mDISH ratios. Review table splits ST&F-style four peak quadrants concurrent-window counts. New build_liver_elevation_table() nested 3/5/10/20x combination-plus-ALP rows. compare = ">=" (default) ">"; footnotes document operator, missing ALP, -treatment vs baseline, ADLB support symptoms / alternative causes / confirmed Hy’s Law. Listing adds R-ratio injury pattern. Teal modules expose plot type, threshold operator, stacked review / elevation tables.

title: tm.hyslaw 0.1.0
text: Initial Hy’s Law / eDISH review builders run without Shiny. Peak eDISH quadrants plus concurrent ALT/AST bilirubin elevations (default 14-day window, aligned admiral Hy’s Law vignette). Optional ALP >= 2x ULN exclusion window. build_hyslaw_table(), hyslaw_listing(), plot_edish(). Teal modules tm_g_edish() tm_t_hyslaw(). Synthetic ADLB fixtures seed four eDISH quadrants, peak-pair outside window, concurrent pair elevated ALP. standardize_adsl() / standardize_adlb() adapters pharmaverseadam CDISC Pilot ADLBC (A1HI, ALKPH).
